svg.title: 直属经理批准的账号恢复 workflow diagram
svg.desc: {"steps":[{"id":"need","name":"需要恢复账号","actor":"employee","type":"event"},{"id":"approve","name":"经理批准恢复","actor":"manager","type":"approval"},{"id":"recover","name":"调用恢复接口","actor":"automation","type":"subprocess"},{"id":"access","name":"恢复账号访问","actor":"employee","type":"outcome"}],"edges":[{"id":"e1","from":"need","to":"approve","kind":"sequence"},{"id":"e2","from":"approve","to":"recover","kind":"conditional","condition":"approved"},{"id":"e3","from":"recover","to":"access","kind":"sequence"}],"coverage":{"mode":"documented_narrative_overview","unknowns":["请求界面、触发器与身份核验机制未披露。","经理拒绝、超时和不响应时的处理未知。","接口失败、部分恢复、重试次数和接口之间的拓扑未知。","没有取得可运行的原生 n8n JSON。"],"inferences":["需求到经理审批的连接是叙事整理。","多个恢复接口合并为一个子流程，未填补内部拓扑。"]}}
